(rule!
  ;; Two magenta endpoints define one horizontal or vertical gap.
  (let* ((pts (find-color g 6))
         (p1 (first pts))
         (p2 (second pts))
         (r1 (fst p1))
         (c1 (snd p1))
         (r2 (fst p2))
         (c2 (snd p2)))
    ;; Preserve endpoints and decorations; paint only the strict interior cyan.
    (if (= r1 r2)
      (reduce (lambda (out c) (set-cell out r1 c 8)) g (range (+ (min c1 c2) 1) (max c1 c2)))
      (reduce (lambda (out r) (set-cell out r c1 8)) g (range (+ (min r1 r2) 1) (max r1 r2))))))
